method: Catalogue match requires normalized full Latin text, genre/function, feast, exact manuscript or printed source and separate notation/version verification. An incipit or Cantus ID alone never proves melodic equivalence.
licensing: Cantus Database/Index material carries CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Metadata links are recorded here, not score images or full musical transcriptions. Check derivative/use rights before embedding, especially where monetisation is contemplated.

candidates.attestation: San Pietro B.79 f093r; Plimpton MS 034 f003v variant
candidates.exclusion: Variant .1 occurs in alternate manuscript; neither proves 1893 or Roman 1962 melody.

candidates.attestation: Budapest lat.118 f219v; manuscript Holy Week
candidates.exclusion: Same text family; not a melody authorization.
One of two optional processional chants in a compound 1893 row. Whole text not collated.
Wilton procession source is not Solesmes 1888 edition, despite current library holding.

candidates.comparisonText: Adorna thalamum tuum Sion et suscipe regem Christum amplectere Mariam
candidates.exclusion: Do not mix with responsory 006051, different text 'quem virgo concepit'; distinguish office antiphon 001293 before melody selection.

candidates.comparisonText: Responsum accepit Simeon a spiritu sancto non visurum se mortem
candidates.attestation: Iowa printed source f005v; indexed processional
candidates.exclusion: The same text incipit in other genre is not automatically this chant; verse Cum inducerent belongs to selected proper context.

candidates.comparisonText: Obtulerunt pro eo domino par turturum aut duos pullos columbarum sicut scriptum est in lege domini
candidates.attestation: Plimpton MS 034 f003r; responsory processional manuscript
candidates.exclusion: Other Cantus 004104 is an office antiphon with shorter text and 007406a is a different responsory verse; 1893 processional genre awaits page score check.

candidates.comparisonText: Pange lingua gloriosi Corporis mysterium sanguinisque pretiosi
candidates.attestation: Paris MS135 f292v; Corpus Christi hymn
candidates.exclusion: Not interchangeable with other Pange lingua (Crux fidelis/Pange lingua gloriosi proelium) and not a Solesmes 1888 melody proof.
Optional 'pro locorum consuetudine' language does not authorize chant for any 1962 Roman procession.

candidates.comparisonText: Procedamus in pace / In nomine Christi Amen
candidates.attestation: GregoBase Vatican 1908 Graduale p146 (with note 1893 PM p54)
candidates.exclusion: Score source is Graduale Romanum 1908, not original 1888. No Cantus identifier asserted.
Historical post-distribution placement excluded under Roman 1962; may be a different chant elsewhere (e.g. Rogations).
